summary: Iteration 43 — Frontend testing of two new Iron Rabbit features from iter_43: (A) Weekly Meal Plan (7-day Mon–Sun grid, week navigation, add/remove/multi-per-day, persistence, build shopping list aggregator, clear week, disabled state) and (B) Cook Notes Search in Recipes modal (title/notes/cook_notes matching, count line, match-vs-last-time note swap with amber/emerald styling, clear-×, combined restaurant + search filter). All 24 target checks PASS live in the browser. Zero console errors. Regression checks on existing recipes testids and NotesApp boot are clean.

action_items: None blocking — both features are production-ready.

Minor/cosmetic: toast messages appear duplicated in DOM ('Added to plan | Added to plan', 'Shopping list: 7 added (from 2 recipes) | Shopping list: 7 added (from 2 recipes)') — likely React 18 StrictMode double-invoke of the click handler, or shadcn Popover dispatching click on both trigger-close and item-click. Consider giving these toasts an id (e.g. toast.success('Added to plan', { id: `mp-add-${date}` })) to dedupe via Sonner, mirroring the pattern used for 'rg-cook-resume' in iter_42.

Minor UX: Meal Plan modal remembers the last-viewed week across close/reopen (state persists because Dialog forceMounts or state survives). If a fresh open should always snap to current week, add an effect on isOpen→true that resets weekStart to mondayOf(new Date()). Not blocking — user has explicit 'This week' button.

Minor UX: when the search returns 0 recipes, the empty state message still reads 'No recipes yet — recreate your favorites.' which is misleading during search (noted in problem statement as known cosmetic quirk).
critical_code_review_comments: RestaurantMealPlanModal.jsx is well-scoped at 228 lines, clean separation of concerns (mondayOf/iso/addDays helpers, memoized entriesByDate map, single reload() source of truth).
buildShoppingList correctly aggregates ingredients from ALL pinned recipes in the current week and delegates dedup/revive to RestaurantsService.addShoppingItems — good reuse.
clearMealPlanRange in restaurantsService.js correctly scopes deletion by from/to (r.date >= from && r.date <= to), so entries in other weeks are preserved (verified live).

Cook-notes match logic (P6 L499-512) correctly prefers most-recent MATCHING note when query is present ('[...notes].reverse().find(...)') and falls back to newest note otherwise. Amber vs emerald styling switch is a clear visual signal.
The filtered useMemo (P6 L363-374) short-circuits on empty query and cleanly composes restaurant filter with substring search across title/notes/cook_notes — proper AND semantics.
meal_plan store is included in exportAll/importAll/computeBackupDiff (restaurantsService.js L774, L855, L958) — future-proof for backup/restore.
Duplicate-toast issue: consider dedup ids on toast.success calls in this file — pattern already used elsewhere (rg-cook-resume). Non-blocking cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: Bootstrapped IndexedDB stores by opening RG dashboard → Meal Plan modal once (creates rg_meal_plan store) → Recipes modal once (creates rg_recipes/rg_restaurants). Then seeded via raw IDB puts to DB 'IronRabbit': rg_restaurants['TEST_REST_1']={name:'TEST Bistro'}, rg_recipes['TEST_REC_A']={title:'Garlic Butter Shrimp', ingredients:['shrimp','butter','garlic','lemon'], cook_notes:[{text:'doubled the garlic — perfect'}]}, rg_recipes['TEST_REC_B']={title:'Simple Pasta', ingredients:['pasta','olive oil','salt'], cook_notes:[{text:'used gluten free noodles'}]}. Cleared rg_meal_plan + rg_shopping_list between runs. NOTE for next agent: localforage uses DB name 'IronRabbit' (not 'rg_v1') with object stores named 'rg_<storeName>'. Stores are created LAZILY on first access, so open each modal once before seeding new stores.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (Weekly Meal Plan + Cook Notes Search) are fully functional with 24/24 checks passing. Persistence, aggregation, filtering, styling, and disabled states all verified. Two minor cosmetic issues to consider for polish (not blocking): (1) toast duplication on click handlers — add Sonner ids like { id: `mp-add-${date}` } to dedupe; (2) meal plan modal state persists across close/reopen (last-viewed week remembered) — could add isOpen effect to snap to current week if desired. Seed pattern for RG features documented above. Both features are included in exportAll/importAll for backup — untested here but code path present.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; features work end-to-end.
